summary: MCS.lean: added the two central bridge lemmas mcs_allFuture_iff / mcs_allPast_iff (from mcs_mp_axiom + the four ProofSystem bridge axioms) plus negated-form companions mcs_not_allFuture_iff / mcs_not_allPast_iff (via not_congr + mcs_mem_iff_neg_not_mem). Repaired all 8 build-error sites (mcs_g_mp x2, mcs_h_mp x2, mcs_g_witness/mcs_h_witness G-bot/H-bot sites x2) by routing through the new bridge lemmas instead of the old defeq-reliant mcs_not_mem_of_neg/mcs_mem_iff_neg_not_mem steps; the G-bot/H-bot sites needed no extra simp since neg bot and top are definitionally the same term (Lukasiewicz encoding). lake build Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Metalogic.MCS is GREEN, no sorry. WitnessSeed.lean: PM8 canary repaired first -- someFuture_allFuture_neg_absurd and somePast_allPast_neg_absurd both fixed with a single mcs_allFuture_iff/mcs_allPast_iff conversion before the final mcs_not_mem_of_neg; canary compiled on first attempt. lake build Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Metalogic.WitnessSeed is GREEN, no sorry, *_neg_absurd signatures unchanged (D4). TemporalContent.lean: audited and repaired 4 sites (g_content_iff_not_neg_in_f_content / p_content_iff_not_neg_in_h_content) via the same bridge lemmas; GREEN. DenseMCS.lean and GenericMCSBridge.lean already built GREEN, no changes needed. Undiscovered dependency: WitnessSeed.lean transitively imports GeneralizedNecessitation.lean, which had its own F1-class break in tempKDistDerived -- a nested-implication conversion (Chi -> (notF-notphi -> notF-notpsi) needed lifting to Chi -> (Gphi -> Gpsi) under a fixed antecedent, not a top-level chain) -- repaired via a dedicated deductionTheorem/assumption/modus_ponens derivation under context [Gphi, G(negpsi->negphi)]. lake build Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Metalogic.GeneralizedNecessitation is GREEN, no sorry. Deferred Phase-4 gate: lake build Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Metalogic.DenseSoundness is now GREEN (was blocked only by the MCS.lean transitive dependency); no DenseSoundness.lean edits were needed. Phase 4 heading flipped [PARTIAL] -> [COMPLETED] in the plan. lean_verify on mcs_allFuture_iff, mcs_allPast_iff, mcs_g_witness, someFuture_allFuture_neg_absurd all report only the 3 standard classical axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), no new axioms beyond the 4 pre-existing bridge axioms.

continuation_context.notes: MCS.lean, WitnessSeed.lean, TemporalContent.lean, GeneralizedNecessitation.lean, DenseMCS.lean, GenericMCSBridge.lean, DenseSoundness.lean are all scoped-build GREEN. The two reusable bridge lemmas are Cslib.Logic.Temporal.mcs_allFuture_iff / mcs_allPast_iff (positive form: X in Omega iff neg(someFuture(neg X)) in Omega) and mcs_not_allFuture_iff / mcs_not_allPast_iff (negated form: X not-in Omega iff someFuture(neg X) in Omega) in MCS.lean, right after mcs_mem_iff_neg_not_mem. Standard repair pattern for an MCS-membership site holding 'GX in Omega' or 'HX in Omega' as a hypothesis that used to be treated as defeq to the neg-someFuture/somePast form: wrap it in (mcs_allFuture_iff h_mcs).mp / (mcs_allPast_iff h_mcs).mp before passing to mcs_not_mem_of_neg or similar. For a site holding the NEGATED form 'GX not-in Omega' as a hypothesis, use (mcs_not_allFuture_iff h_mcs).mp / (mcs_not_allPast_iff h_mcs).mp directly to get 'someFuture(neg X) in Omega'. The *_neg_absurd lemma signatures in WitnessSeed.lean are stable (D4) -- Chronicle consumers (OrderedSeedConsistency, PointInsertion/Splitting, PointInsertion/Since) should need no changes to call sites, only possibly internal defeq-broken bodies. Phase 6 targets: Chronicle/RRelation.lean (neg_allFuture_neg_to_someFuture :499, neg_allPast_neg_to_somePast :479), Chronicle/PointInsertion/Seeds.lean (:54, :92-113), Chronicle/CounterexampleElimination/Structures.lean (:157 'change Formula.allFuture phi in A' site -- replace with mcs_allFuture_iff.mp/.mpr), Chronicle/Frame.lean (:62,:72, verify-only per plan). Watch for the same 'nested implication under a fixed antecedent' pattern seen in GeneralizedNecessitation.lean's tempKDistDerived if any Chronicle site builds a DerivationTree-level (not MCS-membership-level) G/H-distribution fact -- ordinary impTransBase chaining only works for top-level arrows, not implications nested inside another implication's codomain.
